name: Centrosomal microtubule organization for spindle positioning and orientation
rationale: Members concern centrosome/MTOC positioning, microtubule nucleation, anchoring and stability, with astral microtubules, spindle orientation and asymmetric division setting it apart from centrosome-recruitment, centriole-duplication and contractile-ring confusables.

name: Antimicrobial killing of fungi and Gram-positive bacteria
rationale: Members cover direct killing and cytolysis of microbes (metal sequestration, neutrophil cytotoxicity, antifungal humoral response), with yeast and Gram-positive targets distinguishing it from respiratory-burst, iron-assimilation and degranulation confusables.

name: M-CSF signaling in osteoclast formation and bone resorption
rationale: Members span M-CSF/interleukin receptor signaling, macrophage proliferation and fusion, and osteoclast differentiation, fusion and bone resorption, which separates it from GM-CSF/monocyte-differentiation and DAP12 confusables.

name: Recombination-based telomere maintenance and recombination intermediate resolution
rationale: Members concern telomere maintenance via recombination, D-loop/t-circle handling, break-induced replication and capping, with DNA unwinding, resolution of recombination intermediates and intra-S checkpoint distinguishing it from broader telomere and repair confusables.

name: MECP2-mediated neuronal gene regulation and sensory behavior
rationale: Most members are MECP2 transcriptional control of neuronal genes and its loss-of-function variants with histone deacetylation, plus sensory behaviors (touch, proprioception, vision); the MECP2 block distinguishes it from behavior-only confusables.

qualifier: RHOA/B/C and CDC42 with formin activation
name: RHOA-subfamily and CDC42 GTPase cycles with formin activation
rationale: Members are RHO-family GTPase cycles and their effector signaling; RHOA/B/C, RHOD and formin activation distinguish it from RAC-, RND- and PAK/ROCK-centered confusables.

qualifier: pancreatic beta cell, incretin and KATP control
name: Beta-cell insulin secretion and processing with incretin, KATP control
rationale: Members cover beta-cell insulin secretion and its regulation by incretins, fatty acids, glucokinase and KATP channels, plus insulin processing and clearance, distinguishing it from insulin-signaling/GLUT4 confusables.

qualifier: glycogen metabolism and dietary hexose absorption
name: Glycogen metabolism and dietary hexose digestion, absorption, transport
rationale: Members are glycogen synthesis/breakdown and storage diseases plus disaccharide digestion and hexose transporters, distinguishing it from glycolysis/gluconeogenesis, fructose, galactose and urate confusables.

core: Dendritic cell chemokine and cytokine production
name: cGAS-STING-linked CCL5 and dendritic cell cytokine production
rationale: Members concern chemokine (CCL5) and myeloid dendritic cell cytokine production with positive cGAS-STING regulation and cGAMP import, separating it from interferon, TLR7/9 and Th1 confusables.

name: p53 transcriptional targets driving apoptosis and cytochrome c release
rationale: Members are p53-driven transcription of death genes and PUMA/NOXA BH3-only activation leading to cytochrome c release, distinguishing it from anoikis, GO intrinsic-signaling and BAX/BAK MOMP confusables.

qualifier: locomotion, motor learning and cerebellar layer formation
name: Locomotor coordination, motor learning and cerebellar layer formation
rationale: Members cover locomotory and voluntary movement, righting reflex, proprioception and motor learning with cerebellar and striatal development, distinguishing it from vocal, auditory and sensory behavior confusables.

qualifier: elongation braking, termination and R-loop resolution
name: RNA polymerase II elongation braking, termination and R-loop processing
rationale: Members concern regulation of Pol II initiation, elongation and termination with R-loop processing and transcription-linked gene modules, distinguishing it from elongation-complex, Pol I/III and RNA-processing confusables.

name: Telomere maintenance, capping and telomerase Cajal body trafficking
rationale: Members span telomerase extension, recombination-based maintenance, C-strand synthesis, capping and senescence, with telomerase RNA Cajal body localization distinguishing it from general DNA-repair confusables.

name: Proline and glutamine-family amino acid metabolism
rationale: Members are general L-amino acid metabolism with proline synthesis and catabolism and glutamine-family metabolism, distinguishing it from glycine/serine/glyoxylate confusables.

qualifier: hepatic conjugation and organic anion transport
name: Heme catabolism and hepatic bilirubin conjugation and transport
rationale: Members cover heme/tetrapyrrole degradation and the UGT1A conjugation and SLCO/ABCC2 transport whose defects cause hyperbilirubinemia, distinguishing it from drug ADME confusables.

name: Cardiomyocyte growth, proliferation, hypertrophy and contractile force regulation
rationale: Members regulate cardiomyocyte proliferation, differentiation, growth, hypertrophy, survival, heart rate and contraction force, distinguishing it from calcineurin-NFAT and vascular smooth muscle confusables.

qualifier: ribbon disassembly, reassembly and membrane tubulation
name: Golgi ribbon disassembly, reassembly and membrane tubulation
rationale: Members concern Golgi ribbon formation, disassembly/reassembly, positioning and vesicle budding plus membrane tubulation, distinguishing it from secretory-transport and COPI-traffic confusables.

qualifier: COPI retrograde traffic with Rab regulation
name: Golgi organization and COPI retrograde traffic with Rab regulation
rationale: Members cover Golgi architecture, COPI intra-Golgi and Golgi-to-ER traffic, vesicle targeting/tethering and Rab GEF/GAP/prenylation control, distinguishing it from TGN-endosome-lysosome and COPII confusables.

name: Iminoglycinuria from defective proline and glycine transporters
rationale: All three members are SLC36A2/SLC6A20 transporter defects causing iminoglycinuria and hyperglycinuria, distinguishing it from Hartnup, cystinuria and sugar/urate transporter confusables.

core: NK and T cell cytotoxicity regulation
qualifier: MHC class Ib and lymphoid receptor interactions
name: NK and T cell cytotoxicity regulation via MHC class Ib
rationale: Members are NK cell signatures and regulation of NK/T cell cytotoxicity, degranulation and activation, with MHC class Ib presentation and lymphoid-non-lymphoid receptor interactions distinguishing it from granzyme and KIR/tolerance confusables.

qualifier: cartilage morphogenesis and embryonic joint formation
name: Chondrocyte differentiation, cartilage morphogenesis and embryonic joint formation
rationale: Members regulate chondrocyte proliferation, differentiation and hypertrophy, cartilage condensation and joint morphogenesis, distinguishing it from ossification, tendon and articular cartilage homeostasis confusables.

qualifier: base excision and direct alkylation reversal
name: Base excision repair and direct alkylation damage reversal
rationale: Members cover glycosylase defects, AP-site processing and long-patch/gap-filling BER plus ALKBH/MGMT direct reversal, distinguishing it from lesion-recognition, NEIL3 and mismatch repair confusables.

core: Urea cycle citrulline and arginine synthesis
name: Urea cycle citrulline and arginine synthesis, OTC deficiency
rationale: Members are the urea cycle, citrulline and arginine biosynthesis and OTC variant deficiencies, distinguishing it from other urea-cycle enzyme defects and ammonium/ornithine confusables.

name: COPI vesicle budding and ER-Golgi vesicle targeting
rationale: Members concern COPI-coated vesicle budding, Golgi-to-ER retrograde traffic and vesicle targeting between ER and Golgi, distinguishing it from COPII, tethering and ER translocation confusables.

qualifier: B cell development, proliferation and survival
name: BCR signaling and B cell development, proliferation, survival
rationale: Members are BCR signaling and its regulators (CD22, BTK, RAS) with B cell development, proliferation, survival and B cell gene modules, distinguishing it from germinal center, Tfh and plasma cell confusables.

name: High-energy nucleotide, phosphocreatine and NAD(P) cofactor metabolism
rationale: Members cover nucleotide di/triphosphate interconversion, mitochondrial ADP/ATP transport, creatine/phosphocreatine and NAD(P)/nicotinate metabolism, distinguishing it from PRPP, nucleotide-biosynthesis-regulation and apoptosis confusables.

name: Planar cell polarity-driven convergent extension in embryonic morphogenesis
rationale: Members are planar cell polarity establishment and PCP Wnt signaling with convergent extension in gastrulation, axis elongation and neural plate morphogenesis, distinguishing it from axial mesoderm and neural patterning confusables.

name: TLR2/4 bacterial sensing, NLRP inflammasomes and inflammatory cytokine control
rationale: Members cover LPS/lipopeptide TLR2/4 sensing and its MyD88/IRAK4 defects, NLRP1/3 inflammasomes and IL-1 processing, and regulation of inflammatory cytokines, distinguishing it from TRIF, pyroptosis/caspase-4/5 and monocyte confusables.

qualifier: membrane protein insertion and COPII export
name: ER membrane protein insertion and COPII-mediated ER export
rationale: Members cover SRP and tail-anchored/multi-pass protein insertion into the ER, ER retention, and COPII cargo loading and ER-to-Golgi transport, distinguishing it from COPI, ERAD and connexin-trafficking confusables.

qualifier: oncogenic mutants and ERK negative feedback
name: RAF-MEK-ERK cascade, oncogenic mutants and ERK negative feedback
rationale: Members are RAF/MEK/ERK activation, BRAF/RAF1/MAP2K/RAS-pathway mutants and ERK dephosphorylation and feedback suppression, distinguishing it from RAS GAP and SOS/RIT confusables.
